versions.name: Camp Catoctin
versions.address: Catoctin Mountain Park, 14707 Park Central Road

features.note: Units stay in rustic cabins at Camp Round Meadow.
Meals are served cafeteria style in a dining hall.
The canteen doubles as the camp trading post.
An ecology and conservation program area.
A provisional Scout program for those who cannot attend with their unit.

versions.summary: Baltimore Area Council's all-volunteer, nationally accredited Scouts BSA resident camp located in Catoctin Mountain Park within the Maryland mountains, offering merit-badge programming.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
